say:9:1641114007:1.text: To most people, Little Lulu's this elegant, rare creature out of a myth. But to me... it's just a clever kid with a mischievous streak.

say:11:1641114009:1.text: One time, it snuck up and grabbed my wand right off the grass, then darted off with it.
say:11:1641114009:1.source_cn: 结果有一次，它竟然把我放在岸边的魔杖叼进水里。

say:12:1641114010:1.text: I panicked—thought I'd lost my wand for good—until I spotted Little Lulu underwater, waving it around like a trophy.
